title: EF01-P / MT-01: Direct Git, strict test evidence, 12 pytest workers per eligible action
owner: EF01 verification; EF02 host capacity integration
objective: Nâng cấp đường Git/pytest có cấu hình, thêm Minimum Test chọn/reuse/invalidated evidence theo AC và changed dependencies, tích hợp EF01-R/EF02 mà không full-suite lặp vô lý hoặc tạo kết quả PASS giả.

design.current_baseline: subprocess argv uses git directly via PATH; pytest profiles serial; no pytest-xdist declared
design.direct_git: Optional explicit git executable path/GIT executable resolution; no implicit shell/wrapper/hardcoded C:\ path; fallback git on PATH
design.pytest_parallel: HUMAN DEFAULT: -n 12 for EACH eligible local EF01, EF02, repair and fan-in pytest action. Two simultaneous actions each request 12 (24 total). Registered argv stays exact.
design.host_budget: EF02 max_parallel default remains 2. No primary/secondary allocator, host lease, CPU/RAM division or automatic 2/4/8 reduction due to concurrent actions.
design.measurement: HUMAN_REPORTED prior 2/4/8/12/16 trial selected 12 fastest and host capable of 24; no repeat benchmark or capacity gate. Record actual argv/workers/exit/overlap.
design.fallback: Only observed xdist absence, worker launch, severe resource or fixture isolation failure permits logged serial fallback or STOP. A serial registered profile is a disclosed registration gap, not 12-worker proof.

minimum_test.owner: EF01-P; EF02 consumes per-action verification and fan-in evidence
minimum_test.selection: Deterministic smallest sufficient registered pytest set from changed paths, AC, direct/indirect consumers and contract dependencies; never empty only to obtain PASS.
reuse_binding: base and candidate relevant-file hashes or tree/commit
pytest argv/test definitions and runner environment
prior execution exit and immutable artifact refs
minimum_test.invalidation: Changed code, tests, imports/contracts, dependencies, environment or dependency fan-in that could alter claimed covered behavior invalidates corresponding cached PASS. Hash/source mismatch is not eligible for reuse.
minimum_test.ef01_repair: Run failed and affected regression pytest after repair; reuse only evidence remaining valid; retain original selected executor/model/effort and repair budget.
minimum_test.ef02_integration: Action-scoped approved verification plans, preserve claims/fingerprints; at fan-in verify merged candidate's affected consumers, not just sibling PASS results.
minimum_test.safe_fallback: Unknown coverage => broader targeted/full registered profile or UNPROVEN, never fabricated PASS. pytest no-tests/internal/timeout are not success.
minimum_test.registered_profile_constraint: Current EF02 only accepts registered pytest argv; future dynamic selection must remain deterministic/validated, no arbitrary command injection.
minimum_test.xdist_relation: MT-01 chooses sufficient tests independently; every eligible verification action uses twelve workers, including both concurrent actions. Existing protected serial registrations are preserved pending companion change.

acceptance: Explicit Git executable produces safe argv; bad paths/wrappers fail clearly while source provenance and credential behavior remain intact.
Each eligible local EF01, EF02, repair and fan-in pytest verification uses -n 12; default EF02 max_parallel=2 permits two actions requesting 12 each.
Accept Human-reported prior 2/4/8/12/16 comparison and host capacity without a new benchmark gate; log actual argv, launched workers, counts, exits and concurrent spans.
No primary/secondary, host-wide twelve-seat lease or automatic 2/4/8 reduction due to a second action; only observed xdist/launch/resource/fixture failure permits logged serial fallback or STOP.
MT-01 deterministically selects minimal sufficient AC/path/import/test/consumer/contract groups and explains EXECUTE, REUSE, INVALIDATED or UNPROVEN.
Reuse binds relevant base/candidate hashes, definitions/argv, dependencies/environment, AC coverage and immutable successful artifacts; affected changes invalidate proof.
EF01-R retains selected executor/model/effort and bounded action budget, preserves valid PASS and reruns failed/affected tests without duplicate action/provider effects.
EF02 fan-in requires fresh combined consumer/integration proof with validated aggregate/source/file/argv/artifact bindings; sibling PASS alone is UNPROVEN.

Registered pytest argv only; protected registry and RemoteActionBatch v1 remain unchanged here. Existing serial registration is explicitly disclosed; a companion host/PR change is required for authoritative parallel or narrow EF02 profiles.
non_goals: Impose 12 workers on every CI job
Mandatory full-suite after every repair; a new lifecycle/gate; importing AIOS-Renew verification runtime
